title: CBRD-26659 requirement catalogue
description: The requirement catalogue every case, manifest row, matrix row and report line cites. One file, one pin, many requirements. IDs are stable forever; citations, statuses and observations are updated in place.

pin.description: Ticket 11 identities every citation carries. Changing the pin is a recorded decision, never an edit.

engine_baseline.description: Campaign engine baseline commit on feat/oos.

context_revision.description: Committed HEAD of the normative context repository at pin time.

content_hashes.description: sha256 of each cited document's working copy at pin time (the 24-byte wording exists only in the uncommitted copy).

snapshot.description: Repository-relative path of the archived normative snapshot.

baseline_record.description: Repository-relative path of the ticket 11 baseline record.

id.description: Stable identity. The family code is fixed at issue time and never renumbered or reused.

statement.description: The required behavior in normative wording, independent of the pinned engine's output.

seam.description: Where the spec places the cases: CTP SQL runner (public), CTP shell runner (private), or either.

citation.description: Exactly one normative citation: a context heading, an ADR, or an explicitly accepted CBRD design, with the pinned revision and content hash.

source.description: Heading, ADR title, or CBRD design plus the context passage that records its acceptance.

status.description: assertable: expectation fixed and asserted. observation-only: recorded, never asserted as correct. BLOCKED: Specification gap. UNSUPPORTED: accepted design absent at the pin (Capability gap).

policy.description: assert: independently justified expectation. assert-after-eligibility: assert only after proven reclamation eligibility and safety. observe: record, never assert. withhold: no expectation fixed; engine output never promoted.

authority_question.description: Required for BLOCKED: the question the context maintainer must answer.

accepted_design.description: Required for UNSUPPORTED: the accepted CBRD design or ADR that is absent at the pin.

pinned_observation.description: What the pinned engine does, from ticket 11. Observation, never the expectation.

configuration_scope.description: Configurations the requirement applies to when not all (for example client-server only).

attack_dimensions.description: Adversarial dimensions case tickets must cover under this requirement.

expected_engine_findings.description: Engine defects the campaign expects to surface here; a documented Engine defect still records the FAIL outcome.
